\begin{tablenotes}[flushleft]
\footnotesize
\item \textit{Notes:} Rolling forecasts from \rhoosSpanStart{} to \rhoosSpanEnd{} ($T_{\mathrm{oos}} = \rhoosDays$ trading days, each forecast from a model estimated on its trailing window; Section~\ref{sec:rh_results_eval}); Sharpe ratios and HAC $t$-statistics on the \rhrDays{} days of the option-data subsample. QLIKE is the mean loss $\bar L$, with $L_t = \QLIKE(\RV_t, \hat\sigma^2_t)$, $\RV_t$ the actual realized variance of the closing half hour and $\hat\sigma^2_t = \hat y_t^{\,2} s^2_{t,c}$ the variance forecast. $\Delta = 100(\bar L^{\mathrm{Full}}/\bar L^{\mathrm{HAR}} - 1)$, negative when the full predictor set is more accurate, and $\DM$ is the Diebold--Mariano statistic of the daily loss differential (Harvey--Leybourne--Newbold correction; Newey--West lag $q_{\mathrm{NW}} = \rhrDMLag$). $\Delta\SR$ is the change in the annualized Sharpe ratio of the sign strategy at mid-quotes and $t$ the HAC $t$-statistic of the daily return differential ($q_{\mathrm{NW}} = \rhrHACLag$; Section~\ref{sec:rh_methods_tests}). $^{*}$, $^{**}$ and $^{***}$ denote significance at the 10\%, 5\% and 1\% levels. Closing-interval trees use fixed hyperparameters and are re-estimated daily (Section~\ref{sec:rh_exp_schemes}).
\item[a] Full predictor set: the earlier draft's pooled intraday specification.
\item[$\dagger$] Preliminary: the closing-interval forecasts of the pooled intraday random forest on the full predictor set, from an exercise still in progress.
\end{tablenotes}
